## Independent final-review rejection and author remediation

Frozen516c049 was rejected C0/H2/M0/L0. This rejected candidate remains in Git;
the exact uncommitted manifest and reviewer-authored rejection are losslessly
retained below. They are never represented as an accepted attestation.
H1: live closure proof routes bypassed validation after the policy attestation.
Author fix validates the live maintenance record inside the immutable policy envelope
so exact routes cannot be bypassed, without freezing unrelated later stage state.
H2: future closure candidate could self-consistently hash runtime edits. Author fix
compares the entire baseline/candidate Git trees against finite closure-only paths;
rejects runtime/package/lock/config/CI changes including modes/additions/deletions,
permits independently evolved baseline, and limits state delta to exact proof pointer.
Actual repo-adapter regression and a temporary real-Git fixture exercise both fixes.
Reviewer did not edit or repair the candidate; replacement final review is required.

The real supported-host exact build log/exit0 above predates H1/H2 fixes. It is not
claimed to rebuild the final scripts. Contract section5 permits unchanged runtime/
dependency-byte binding; independent reviewer confirmed this interpretation.
Final delta from saved build bindings is confined to sd2-held-closure-governance.ts
and test-sd2-held-closure-governance.ts. Production runtime/import closure, dependencies,
lockfile, build command/package, Next/TypeScript configuration and runtime build
inputs are unchanged. P9 runtime test independently recomputes the same41file
closure f92802e9c85fa50afc2300ba66c248cc4ecf1f8bc86038616d5ca49d9496a52d.
Fresh final required typecheck covers the remediated scripts (included by tsconfig);
fresh full tests include the real Git regressions. This is precise reuse under
the existing same-runtime/dependency clause, not an invented new build or gate waiver.

Original attention remains owned/routed in the exact preserved open-items artifact.
Revision22 implementation/review/delivery only: no separate research closure is
selected or accepted, no facts/mappings/source/workbook/monitoring effect, no SD3.
